checks: Both modes exact prompt + A–C; correctly numbered. Only “Not yet; I will review it after lunch” answers completion status; translations/explanations equivalent. English options, zh-TW and each rationale checked; offline ASR and visual review, not runtime acceptance.

activeQuestion.prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 聆聽問題或陳述，選出最合適的回應。

options.text: The meeting room is on the left.
options.whyZh: layout 在此指電路板佈局，回答會議室方向不合題意。

options.text: Yes, I would like some lunch.
options.whyZh: 問題不是邀請用餐，而是確認檢查是否完成。

options.text: Not yet; I will review it after lunch.
options.whyZh: Not yet 回答目前尚未完成，並交代下一步。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: Not yet 回答目前尚未完成，並交代下一步。
activeQuestion.evidence: Have you checked the board layout yet?

vocabulary.note: 指元件與線路的配置；check 表示檢查其設計。

group.title: Board review
group.passage:
Have you checked the board layout yet?
A. The meeting room is on the left.
B. Yes, I would like some lunch.
C. Not yet; I will review it after lunch.
